description: Log a habit entry for a date. Sets the value for a day (0 clears it). Without a value the day is marked fully done.

date.description: Date to log (Y-m-d, defaults to today, cannot be in the future)

value.description: Value to set for that day (default: the habit's full daily target, i.e. done). 0 clears the day. Count/duration habits are only done when value >= target.

name: log_habit
title: Log habit
